children: Smith & Wesson Brands reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results with net sales of $112.6 million and GAAP net income of $2.6 million, or $0.06 per diluted share, for the quarter ended July 31, 2026. Gross margin improved to 28.7% (including a $2.9 million tariff refund that contributed ~260 basis points). Management reaffirmed revenue growth expectations for fiscal 2027 and authorized a $0.13 per share quarterly dividend.
Net sales: $112.6 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (up $27.5 million, or 32.3%, year-over-year).
Gross profit: $32.3 million; Gross margin: 28.7% (compared with 25.9% in prior-year quarter). Tariff refunds of $2.9 million favorably impacted margin by ~260 basis points and were non-recurring.
Operating income: $4.2 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026.
GAAP net income: $2.6 million; Diluted net income per share: $0.06 (vs. net loss of $3.4 million, or $(0.08) per diluted share, in the comparable quarter).
Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDAS: $13.8 million, representing 12.2% of net sales (compared with $7.4 million, or 8.7% of net sales, in the prior-year quarter).
Management cited solid demand across both consumer and professional channels as drivers of year-over-year revenue growth and stronger profitability.
Company attributed momentum to continued focus on product innovation, industry partnerships, and operational execution tied to the Smith & Wesson and Gemtech brands.
Board authorized a $0.13 per share quarterly dividend, payable October 1, 2026 to shareholders of record on September 17, 2026, reflecting capital allocation priorities.
Company expects a normal seasonal environment and anticipates second-quarter sales roughly 10% above prior year; fiscal 2027 revenue expected to grow approximately 5–7% over fiscal 2026.
